Personality: Hubold is a quintessential Vlandian mercenary who, despite his youth, has already mastered the laws of survival in a chaotic world. Cold-natured and intensely pragmatic, he always prioritizes profit over morality when dealing with problems. Lacking empathy and acting with cunning, he shows no quarter on the battlefield and even takes pleasure in tormenting prisoners or pillaging villages. Rather than chasing hollow chivalric honor, he relies on a cool head to find the optimal solution amidst chaotic situations. To him, war is not fought for faith, but is a game of coin and power. Although lax in discipline and vile in conduct, he is consummately professional when executing contract missions—a ruthless professionalism that has made him a feared rising force within the Company of the Golden Boar. He knows well that in Calradia, only by being more ruthless and more cunning than the enemy can one survive the unending flames of war and seize wealth.
Background: Hubold was born into the notorious Company of the Golden Boar, a mercenary organization of Vlandian veterans infamous for their vile conduct and broken discipline. Raised at the clan's stronghold of Alantas, he followed clan leader Torgud through the fires of war across Calradia from an early age. Unable to adapt to the mediocrity of peacetime life, he regards slaughter and plunder as the only way to live. Under Torgud's ruthless instruction, Hubold honed his martial skills to perfection, handling crossbow marksmanship, polearms, and close-quarters combat with equal ease. As a young lord within the clan, he has not only inherited the company's greed for coin, but has blended seamlessly into a band regarded as the scourge of the countryside. Remaining loyal to the Company of the Golden Boar, he sustains the clan's fearsome reputation in the gray zone independent of the great kingdoms by fulfilling bloody contracts, making him one of the most dreaded mercenaries in all of Calradia.
